h: BBNaija's Chomzy welcomes second child on husband's birthday
p: Former BBNaija housemate Chomzy has announced the birth of her second son, revealing that she and her husband kept the pregnancy private. The baby arrived on her husband's birthday.
body: Former Big Brother Naija housemate Chomzy has become a mother of two.

In an Instagram post on Friday, 13 November 2026, Chomzy shared a video with her husband and sons, revealing that their second child had arrived on her husband's birthday. She said the couple had deliberately kept the pregnancy out of public view so they could enjoy the experience privately before sharing the news.
Chomzy described the new baby as a precious blessing and the start of a beautiful new chapter for the family, and used the post to celebrate her husband on his birthday.
Chomzy was a housemate on the sixth season of Big Brother Naija in 2021.
more: The baby arrived on her husband's birthday.
The couple kept the pregnancy private.
